prompt:
GAME BUTTON ICON. Seen straight from the side, flat, like a road sign. One object, centred, filling about three quarters of the canvas.

Create an ORIGINAL game button icon: the side of a truck cab door with its window wound right down, and a big puffy cloud of grey smoke pouring out of the open window and rising above the door into the open air. Images 1 and 2 are our approved button icons: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

The window opening is empty, with only the top edge of the lowered glass showing at the bottom of the opening. The smoke starts inside the opening and billows out past the door's top edge, so most of the cloud is clearly outside the vehicle.

Draw ONLY this, alone on a plain pure white background.

Style: a button icon for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted colours, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64 pixels: three big shapes, few small ones.

No people, hands, text, letters, numbers, logos, arrows, ground or cast shadow.
